design.edits: Preserve the submitted pictures. Copy a same-speaker excerpt around the target letter midpoint from another recording under the same condition. Use a 420 ms edit, center-aligned with 8 ms edge blends and at most 3 dB level adjustment. Include analogous same-letter dubs, gain, low-pass and constant 120 ms offsets.
design.measure: Read audible M proposals independently. Require emission >= 0.55, and a second M reading from a 3.4 kHz low-pass copy within 40 ms. Use median clock bias from development genuine M. Compare minimum observed lip aperture within 100 or 160 ms of the corrected acoustic event. Require at least four consecutive native pictures with complete mouth geometry and at most 50 ms per step.
design.points: Use strict exceedance above the highest (tight) and second-highest (broad) ordinary development speaker maxima, with floor 0.060. Select the strongest aperture observation per file and each window size.
design.sources: Source codes outside the two phone-timing panels and earlier exclusion list. Choose six development speakers by hash order, then use all remaining qualified speakers. Require plain and Lombard conditions for each speaker, each with two M and two A or I utterances. Choose from publisher labels and media availability before any detector inference.
design.utility: For the known changed interval, require the scored event inside the inserted M and 0.40 temporal IoU. No AI authorship claim. Flag an ordinary control as a false local-edit lead even when a constant offset is present.
